'''Howe Walwahd''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] who worked as an independent sailor in the seas of [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]].

==History==
Her ship was rammed by a [[222 fishing trawler]] from [[Bartyn Gourmet Delicacies]], and destroyed because of this. Besides, she lost a leg in the accident and used an artificial replacement since.

Needing a new job, Walwahd became a dockmaster in [[Bartyn's Landing]], reluctantly working for the same [[Guther Bartyn]] who owned Bartyn Gourmet Delicacies. She disliked that surname and was rude with anyone working for Bartyn &mdash; which meant almost everyone. Nonetheless, she methodically reported anything of importance during her guard, including the sight of [[Menahuun]]s.

In [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], Walwahd was on duty when Menahuuns were detected in Bartyn's well-protected yacht ''[[Tria Blue]]''. After Bartyn's guards were killed, Walwahd asked for medical help and for a mortuary [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] before she was possibly killed by the Menahuuns during the attack.

Walwahd also had a cousin who worked in a private trawler in [[Cape Regret]], and they were in contact over the years.<ref name="Reckonings" />
